topic: Particle Nature and Classification of Matter
key_concepts: Gas particles move randomly and quickly in straight-line paths
Solid particles are held by strong forces and only vibrate in fixed positions
Gases can be compressed because their particles are far apart
Matter is classified into pure substances and mixtures
Pure substances include elements and compounds
Mixtures may be homogeneous or heterogeneous
Density indicates how tightly packed a material is
Heating causes particles to move farther apart and changes volume
Pollutants occur as solids, liquids, and gases
Particle arrangement and forces explain the properties of states of matter
